SETTLED:
1) Score is per block at the same height, divided by the taller tower. One word is one block, in word order, repeats included. Extra blocks score 0 but count in the divisor. Full match = 1, colour-only or shape-only = 0.25.
2) Messages hold at most 8 words. A target of N>8 blocks caps at 8/N. Cover the first 8 blocks. Last round confirmed this: 9-block target, 7.25/9 = 0.81.
3) Word table: tumu = blue cube, neto = yellow ring, fuza = green star, kuru = purple ball, tido = blue ring, muva = yellow ball, dobo = orange ball, vonu = yellow star, melu = green ball, vepu = red ring, kano = green cube, loku = orange cube, fidi = red cube, zeki = orange cone, nove = red star.
4) Builders build exactly one block per word using this table. The new partner did too.
5) With no exact word, use the closest confirmed word for 0.25: kuru for any purple shape, tido for blue star, muva for yellow cone or yellow cube, fuza for green cone, dobo or loku for orange ring or orange star.
6) Use melu for green ball, not fuza.

OPEN:
1) mape built purple cone x3 in an early round. It probably means purple cone, but that has not been confirmed. It is not green cube.
2) No exact word known for: orange ring, orange star, purple ring, purple star, purple cube, red cone, yellow cone, yellow cube, green cone, blue star. All 16 words are assigned, so these stay at 0.25 via the closest word.
3) Repeated costly blocks (purple ring, purple star, green cone) cost points each time.

TRY NEXT:
1) As sender, spend the 8 words on the first 8 blocks. Use exact words where known, otherwise the closest word.
2) Test mape on a purple cone target block to confirm it.
3) As builder, build one block per word using the table above. For mape build purple cone.

SETTLED:
1. Score is shared and divided by the taller tower. Max 8 words, one word per block, in order. A full block scores 1, one right attribute 0.25. Targets of 9+ blocks cap at 8/9 or lower, so name the first 8.
2. Confirmed words: kuru = purple ball, neto = yellow ring, fuza = green star, muva = yellow ball, dobo = orange ball, loku = orange cube, tido = blue ring, tumu = blue cube, vonu = yellow star, kano = green cube, melu = green ball, vepu = red ring.
3. Repeated word means repeated blocks. Builders build exactly what the meanings say, so the vocabulary is shared across partners.
4. A stand-in word sharing colour or shape gives 0.25 per block. Confirmed again this round: fuza for green cone built a green star, and the score was 0.81 (7.25/9).
5. Check every word against the confirmed list before sending. Do not use fuza for green ball.
6. Exact words early and stand-ins for blocks with no word work well. Leading with long runs of exact words scores high.

OPEN:
1. No known word for green cone, orange cone, orange ring, orange star, purple star, purple cube, purple ring, yellow cone, blue star, or red anything except red ring.
2. Unknown words: mape (not green cube, not purple cone), nove, zeki, fidi. zeki and nove as orange cone and red star scored 0. They may mean purple ring, but this is unconfirmed.
3. Do not use melu or vepu for orange blocks.
4. Unknown whether a tail beyond 8 blocks matters. It cannot be named anyway.

NEXT:
1. As describer: use confirmed words where they fit. For blocks with no exact word, use a stand-in with the same colour or shape (purple star: kuru; green cone: fuza or melu; orange cone: dobo or loku; blue star: tido).
2. Test one unknown word (zeki, nove, fidi, mape) in the last slot, ideally for purple ring, and record what gets built.
3. As builder: trust confirmed words. For unknown words, guess a colour or shape that continues the neighbouring pattern, and learn from the revealed target.
4. Match block count to word count and do not pad.
